review_type: Owner-authorized AI adjudication of retained evidence

backlog.rationale: Accept the attributed July draft-study discussion and September 8 comment deadline. Do not describe final policy, approved infrastructure or delivered capacity.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess when a final study, adopted policy or specific delivered-capacity record replaces the draft discussion.

backlog.rationale: Reject a combined AI/cyber trend: recommendation populations, repeated fiscal-year observations and unrecovered inventory versions are incompatible. Retain individually dated agency findings.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess only with matched agency populations, nonduplicated periods and recovered inventory versions.

backlog.rationale: Reject the cross-domain asset-performance composite. Capacity, customer interruptions, reuse activities and mineral catalog entries have different units and populations.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess with a single defined asset population, compatible units and a reproducible observation series.

backlog.rationale: Accept the corrected survey-response description and separately attributed program statistics. Reject one manufacturing outcome trend across MEP, institute activity and establishment statistics.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess a manufacturing comparison after recovering consistent survey definitions, program populations and denominators.

backlog.rationale: Reject a common transport/space service-outcome measure. Carrier populations, testing exclusions, launch units and reporting calendars do not match.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess only with explicit carrier or launch units, matching reporting periods and test exclusions.

backlog.rationale: Reject cross-agency cybersecurity ranking from unlike samples, score methods and audit cutoffs. Retain bounded historical audit attribution only.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess after harmonizing agency samples, scoring methods and audit cutoffs; do not infer current performance from old audits.

backlog.rationale: Reject battery availability ranking from inventory power and inaccessible archive rows. Plant-row reproduction and a defined operating denominator are substantive evidence requirements.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess when plant rows are reproducible and a source defines observed availability, operating period and denominator.

backlog.rationale: Permit a source-located descriptive carrier table only after exact operating-carrier rows and revisions are reproduced. Reject an overall carrier-performance ranking and marketing-network substitution.
backlog.reopening_condition: Publish a descriptive candidate table locally once exact operating-carrier rows and revisions are reproduced; rankings require a comparable denominator.

backlog.rationale: Reject a cross-manufacturer productivity ranking and causal effect. Client/program reports use unlike outputs and periods, and the Current Applications multiplier discrepancy must remain visible.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess when the Current Applications multiplier discrepancy is resolved and same-line inputs, outputs and periods are available.

backlog.rationale: Reject a causal explanation of FISMA movement from control activity. Changed samples, metrics, intervention scopes and cutoffs prevent the proposed comparison.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess only with stable samples, comparable metrics and a defensible intervention-to-outcome design.

backlog.rationale: Reject battery-outcome causation from capacity and corrective-action responses. Target dates and operator closure assertions do not establish regulatory acceptance or measured service.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess when regulatory acceptance and measured service records are available, separately from operator targets.

backlog.rationale: Reject the inference that carrier commitments were delivered or caused annual cancellation changes. Recovering displayed promises would still not prove passenger-level delivery.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess delivered remedies only with passenger-level or equivalent delivery evidence and an appropriate comparison design.

backlog.rationale: Reject causal or persistent production improvement from capabilities, grants, acquisition and certification narratives. Keep facility continuity and same-line inputs/outputs separate.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess after establishing facility and production-line continuity with dated inputs and outputs.

backlog.rationale: Accept the specifically located, dated recommendation closure as an attributed finding. Reject transfer to other recommendations, current agency effectiveness or causal risk reduction.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess if a dated source changes the identified recommendation state; effectiveness requires separate outcome evidence.

backlog.rationale: Reject a common availability, safety or value score from cleanup, planned removal, restart and contract records. Preserve their different dates and asset boundaries.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess each asset against a defined operating measure, period and denominator; do not combine cleanup and restart milestones.

backlog.rationale: Accept the correction that the February artifact includes annual tables. Keep May operations, oversales quarters and complaint reporting separate; reject service-delivery or causal inference.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess only after matching annual, monthly and quarterly carrier tables and their distinct populations.

backlog.rationale: Accept the bounded company-name/address match. Reject claims of unchanged ownership, persistent same-line output or current safety from a historical inspection.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess ownership, same-line output or safety only with records that establish those properties for the relevant period.

backlog.rationale: Accept supplier clauses as requirements only. Reject achieved capability, certificate validity or production outcomes inferred from a listing, filename or unread image.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess achieved supplier capability only with readable evidence of certificate validity and applicable production outcomes.

backlog.rationale: Reject manufacturer defect rates and causal line-performance claims from unmatched roles, enforcement, requirements and failed MDR queries. Do not substitute alternate queries or infer zero events.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess defect rates only after matching manufacturer roles, recovered MDR events, time at risk and production denominators.

backlog.rationale: Accept the corrected VA-title and DOE-letter framing and distinct recommendation states. Reject an agency ranking; administrative closure, audit quality and implementation remain different.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess recommendation status using a source-located change for that recommendation; do not turn administrative closure into effectiveness.

backlog.rationale: Reject cross-battery availability, safety, value and causal ranking. Retain event-specific and project-attributed findings; unresolved service, period and formula boundaries prevent series admission.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess a battery series only with matching asset, service, observation period, units and documented formulas.

backlog.rationale: Accept source-located descriptive operating-carrier observations and displayed commitments with their periods. Reject composite quality/readiness ranking and delivered-remedy claims.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess delivered remedies with evidence of actual delivery; keep source-located carrier observations separate from commitments.

backlog.rationale: Reject cross-aircraft-line productivity ranking. Cumulative delivery, lateness, readiness and program governance are not a common accepted-output denominator.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess aircraft productivity only with consistent accepted output, line inputs, periods and treatment of late deliveries.

backlog.rationale: Accept the bounded contextual coverage notice. Reject converting source coverage into performance ranking, universal source currency or closure of missing records.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess coverage when a specific missing artifact is recovered or a source changes; no universal freshness claim follows.

backlog.rationale: Accept the corrected source-specific acquisition status. Reject six assumed closures, monthly production from cumulative totals, and availability from capacity or queue metadata.
backlog.reopening_condition: Reassess acquisition, monthly production or availability only with records that directly establish the respective state or measure.

portfolio.policy: Count a separately identified project once, not its repeated registry/control rows. An eligible identity is not yet a completed dossier. Multi-project comparisons and program parents are contextual unless separately split and reviewed. Place dossiers may use a clearly named municipality, county, region, corridor, campus or basin; do not pretend these scopes are interchangeable.

montana.decision: 32 distinct source-project identities are eligible for individual dossiers; the 768 registry rows are not projects.
